n1.speaker: npc_marrow
n1.text: Sit. No, stand; it's that sort of occasion. Six souls, and you checked the last one against the archive when the file told you not to.

n2.speaker: npc_marrow
n2.text: This arrived from the Auditor-General's office within the hour. It "commends your vigilance".

n3.speaker: npc_marrow
n3.text: It confirms your elevation to Senior Adjudicator, effective now, and asks that the Tarrow file be forwarded to the Office of Reconciliation.

n5.speaker: npc_marrow
n5.text: I have worked here three hundred years. I have never been commended within the hour for anything.

n6.speaker: narrator
n6.text: She unpins the grey cuffs from your sleeves and sets down a pair edged in gold and red.

n7.speaker: npc_marrow
n7.text: Senior Adjudicators hear appeals. That means souls somebody else already judged, and files somebody else already touched.

n8.speaker: npc_marrow
n8.text: The stair in the court is open to you. Grist will pretend he never stopped you.

n9.speaker: npc_marrow
n9.text: As for the Tarrow file. I am required to tell you to send it up. I have now told you.

choices.text: Forward it, but ask Pell to keep his copy.

close.speaker: npc_marrow
close.text: Noted. Or rather, not noted. Go on. One at a time.
